prompt: Retry a flaky call with exponential backoff: return the first success, report the doubling waits to a DelayLog instead of sleeping, and give up with the last failure as the cause.
explanation: A retry loop has three exits -- success, an argument that makes retrying meaningless, and exhaustion -- and each needs its own path. Keeping a reference to the most recent failure lets the give-up exception carry it as a cause, so the eventual stack trace still names the real problem instead of only saying that retries ran out. Reporting the wait through a DelayLog instead of calling Thread.sleep is what makes the method testable: the backoff schedule becomes an observable value, and the guard attempt < maxAttempts encodes the rule that nobody waits after the final try.
hints: Validate maxAttempts before the loop, then count attempt from 1 to maxAttempts inclusive.
Inside the loop the attempt call sits in the try and returns its result directly -- returning is what ends the retries. The catch stores the failure in a variable declared outside the loop.

Only report a delay while attempt < maxAttempts; baseMillis * (1L << (attempt - 1)) doubles it each time. After the loop, throw IllegalStateException with the stored failure as the second constructor argument.
